message: TypeError: Object of type bool is not JSON serializable
cause: The final target predicate was numpy.bool_ because interval widths came from a NumPy array.
observed_scope: All eight numerical controls returned before json.dump; the final output write failed. Numeric assertions did not report a failure, but their unpersisted results were not accepted as a completed deliverable.
fix: Convert the final target predicate to builtin bool. Reexecute the same new synthetic control command to produce the lost complete artifact. No HE32/HE33 science suite is involved.
